items.title: Confirm whether to proceed with the Gutachten (soil/moisture survey)
items.quote: Bitte geben Sie uns innerhalb von 15 Werktagen nach dem Briefdatum Bescheid, ob wir das Gutachten erstellen sollen; als Werktage zählen Montag bis Samstag, nicht aber Sonn- und Feiertage.
items.computation: The letter itself fixes both the start and the counting rule: the period runs from the Briefdatum (2026-11-20, a Friday) and 'Werktage' are defined by the letter as Monday to Saturday, excluding Sundays and public holidays — i.e. the start day is not counted, matching the ordinary German convention (§ 187 BGB) for a period 'nach' a date. Counting 15 such Werktage from 2026-11-20 (skipping the Sundays 2026-11-22, 2026-11-29 and 2026-12-06; no NRW public holiday falls in this window) lands on Tuesday, 2026-12-08. As the 15th Werktage day is itself a working day under the letter's own definition, no further shift is needed.
